name: Easy Store Management by AyudaWP
author: Fernando Tellado

sections.description:
Easy Store Management by AyudaWP transforms the WordPress admin dashboard into a clean, focused store management environment specifically designed for WooCommerce shop managers.

Key Features:

  • Clean Interface: Hides all non-store related WordPress menus and widgets from shop managers
  • Reorganized Menus: Moves important WooCommerce sections like Orders and Customers to top-level menus
  • Focused Dashboard: Removes WordPress widgets, keeping only WooCommerce-related dashboard widgets
  • Enhanced Admin Bar: Adds quick access to orders and removes non-store elements
  • Role-Based: Only affects users with the “Shop Manager” role – administrators and other roles remain unaffected

What gets hidden/reorganized:

  • WordPress core menus (Posts, Pages, Comments, Users, Tools, etc.)
  • Non-WooCommerce plugin menus
  • WordPress dashboard widgets (Quick Draft, At a Glance, etc.)
  • Non-store items from admin bar

Menu reorganization:

  1. Dashboard (WordPress default)
  2. Store (renamed WooCommerce main menu)
  3. Orders (promoted to top-level)
  4. Customers (promoted to top-level)
  5. Products (existing top-level menu)

This plugin is perfect for store owners who want to provide their shop managers with a clean, distraction-free environment focused solely on store operations.

For Developers

Easy Store Management by AyudaWP provides extensive customization options through hooks and filters, making it perfect for custom implementations and advanced integrations.

Available Filters

ayudawp_esm_allowed_menus
Customize which menus are visible to shop managers.

add_filter('ayudawp_esm_allowed_menus', function($allowed_menus) {
    $allowed_menus[] = 'edit.php?post_type=custom_post';
    return $allowed_menus;
});

ayudawp_esm_menus_to_remove
Control which menus should be hidden from shop managers.

add_filter('ayudawp_esm_menus_to_remove', function($menus_to_remove) {
    $menus_to_remove[] = 'custom-plugin-menu';
    return $menus_to_remove;
});

ayudawp_esm_widgets_to_remove
Manage dashboard widgets removal.

add_filter('ayudawp_esm_widgets_to_remove', function($widgets) {
    $widgets[] = 'custom_dashboard_widget';
    return $widgets;
});

ayudawp_esm_show_simplified_interface
Control which user roles see the simplified interface.

add_filter('ayudawp_esm_show_simplified_interface', function($show, $user) {
    // Also show to editors
    if (in_array('editor', $user->roles)) {
        return true;
    }
    return $show;
}, 10, 2);

ayudawp_esm_admin_bar_remove
Customize admin bar items removal.

add_filter('ayudawp_esm_admin_bar_remove', function($items) {
    $items[] = 'custom-admin-bar-item';
    return $items;
});

ayudawp_esm_admin_bar_add
Add custom admin bar items.

add_filter('ayudawp_esm_admin_bar_add', function($items) {
    $items['custom-reports'] = array(
        'id' => 'custom-reports',
        'title' => 'Custom Reports',
        'href' => admin_url('admin.php?page=custom-reports'),
    );
    return $items;
});

ayudawp_esm_welcome_panel_content
Customize the welcome panel content.

add_filter('ayudawp_esm_welcome_panel_content', function($content) {
    return '<div>Custom welcome message</div>';
});

ayudawp_esm_custom_page_titles
Customize page titles for shop managers.

add_filter('ayudawp_esm_custom_page_titles', function($titles) {
    $titles['custom-page.php'] = 'My Custom Page';
    return $titles;
});

Available Actions

ayudawp_esm_loaded
Fired when Easy Store Management is fully loaded.

add_action('ayudawp_esm_loaded', function() {
    // Your custom initialization code here
});

ayudawp_esm_before_menu_customization
Execute code before menu customizations are applied.

add_action('ayudawp_esm_before_menu_customization', function() {
    // Pre-menu customization code
});

ayudawp_esm_after_menu_customization
Execute code after menu customizations are applied.

add_action('ayudawp_esm_after_menu_customization', function() {
    // Post-menu customization code
});

ayudawp_esm_before_widgets_customization
Execute code before dashboard widgets customization.

add_action('ayudawp_esm_before_widgets_customization', function() {
    // Pre-widgets customization code
});

ayudawp_esm_after_widgets_customization
Execute code after dashboard widgets customization.

add_action('ayudawp_esm_after_widgets_customization', function() {
    // Post-widgets customization code
});

Complete Integration Example

<?php
/**
 * Custom Easy Store Management Integration
 */

// Add custom post type to allowed menus
add_filter('ayudawp_esm_allowed_menus', 'custom_esm_add_menus');
function custom_esm_add_menus($allowed_menus) {
    $allowed_menus[] = 'edit.php?post_type=shop_coupon';
    $allowed_menus[] = 'admin.php?page=custom-reports';
    return $allowed_menus;
}

// Remove specific plugin menu
add_filter('ayudawp_esm_menus_to_remove', 'custom_esm_remove_menus');
function custom_esm_remove_menus($menus_to_remove) {
    $menus_to_remove[] = 'some-plugin-menu';
    return $menus_to_remove;
}

// Show interface to custom role
add_filter('ayudawp_esm_show_simplified_interface', 'custom_esm_show_to_role', 10, 2);
function custom_esm_show_to_role($show, $user) {
    if (in_array('store_assistant', $user->roles)) {
        return true;
    }
    return $show;
}

// Add custom admin bar item
add_filter('ayudawp_esm_admin_bar_add', 'custom_esm_admin_bar_items');
function custom_esm_admin_bar_items($items) {
    $items['quick-reports'] = array(
        'id' => 'quick-reports',
        'title' => '<span class="ab-icon dashicons dashicons-chart-bar"></span>Reports',
        'href' => admin_url('admin.php?page=wc-reports'),
        'meta' => array(
            'title' => 'Quick access to reports',
        ),
    );
    return $items;
}

// Custom initialization
add_action('ayudawp_esm_loaded', 'custom_esm_init');
function custom_esm_init() {
    // Your custom code here
    if (class_exists('AyudaWP_ESM_Hooks')) {
        // Plugin is loaded and ready
    }
}
?>
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/easy-store-management-ayudawp directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. The plugin will automatically apply customizations for users with the “Shop Manager” role.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin affect administrators?

No, this plugin only affects users with the “Shop Manager” role. Administrators will continue to see the full WordPress admin interface.

Can I customize which menus are hidden?

Yes! The plugin provides extensive customization options through hooks and filters. See the “For Developers” section for complete documentation and examples of how to customize menus, widgets, and more.

Will this work with other WooCommerce extensions?

Yes, the plugin is designed to preserve WooCommerce-related menus from extensions and only hide core WordPress and non-WooCommerce plugin menus.

What happens if I deactivate WooCommerce?

The plugin checks for WooCommerce on activation and will show an admin notice if WooCommerce is not active. The customizations will not apply without WooCommerce.
